analysis.observed: Worker exited or no staging event won before interruption; child output was not preserved.
analysis.identified_race: Unpaused staging relies on FileSystemWatcher delivery and process liveness; publication can finish first.
analysis.old_child_exit_reason: not recoverable from the archived artifacts

repair.handshake: Poll and parse the persisted checkpoint; bind its attempt ID to the SQLite Staging row; verify real staged snapshot files before killing the process tree.
repair.recovery: Require Quarantined or Failed plus zero remaining staging files.
repair.diagnostics: Drain both child pipes; persist exit/status/checkpoint/child TRX under logs/ci; kill and drain descendants on all paths.
